name: Generative AI for Beginners
summary: Microsoft's 21-lesson course on building generative AI apps, with videos, Python and TypeScript samples.
description: A 21-lesson course on generative AI fundamentals and applications. Lessons are labeled Learn or Build and cover prompt engineering, chat apps, vector search, image generation, function calling, RAG, agents and fine-tuning; each includes a short video, a written lesson, Python and TypeScript code samples for Azure OpenAI or the OpenAI API, and a Keep Learning section.
contains: 21 lessons numbered 00-21, labeled Learn or Build
each lesson: video, written lesson, Python and TypeScript samples, extra learning links
code runs on Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry Models, OpenAI API or Foundry Local
